<!--DATA-->

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const $=(s,r=document)=>r.querySelector(s);
const $$=(s,r=document)=>Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s));
const NS="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
const reduce=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
function load(id){return JSON.parse(document.getElementById(id).textContent);}
function unpack(t){return t.data.map(a=>{const o={};t.cols.forEach((c,i)=>{o[c]=a[i];});return o;});}
function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]));}
const f3=v=>(v==null||isNaN(v))?"n/a":v.toFixed(3);
const f2=v=>(v==null||isNaN(v))?"n/a":v.toFixed(2);
const sgn=v=>(v>=0?"+":"−")+Math.abs(v).toFixed(3);
const pct=v=>(100*v).toFixed(1)+"%";

/* ---------- data ---------- */
const SIGD=load("data-sig"), ED=load("data-e"), FREED=load("data-free"), KC=load("data-kcurve"), REN=load("data-rename"), REC=load("data-recorded");
const SS=unpack(SIGD.sentences), SR=unpack(SIGD.rows);
const ES=unpack(ED.sentences), ER=unpack(ED.rows);
const FR=unpack(FREED.rows);
const [Q1,Q2]=ED.tercile_cuts;
const eTerc=w=>w<=Q1?"T1":w<=Q2?"T2":"T3";
const bySent=new Map(); SR.forEach((r,i)=>{r.i=i;if(!bySent.has(r.s))bySent.set(r.s,[]);bySent.get(r.s).push(r);});
const eBySent=new Map(); ER.forEach((r,i)=>{r.i=i;if(!eBySent.has(r.s))eBySent.set(r.s,[]);eBySent.get(r.s).push(r);});
const sigWordRange={};SS.forEach(s=>{const x=sigWordRange[s.wt]||(sigWordRange[s.wt]=[1e9,0]);x[0]=Math.min(x[0],s.w);x[1]=Math.max(x[1],s.w);});

/* ---------- AUROC (ties count one half); stratified = sum of within-stratum U over sum of within-stratum pairs ---------- */
function mannU(p,n){const a=p.map(v=>[v,1]).concat(n.map(v=>[v,0])).sort((x,y)=>x[0]-y[0]);let U=0,below=0,i=0;
  while(i<a.length){let j=i,np=0,nn=0;while(j<a.length&&a[j][0]===a[i][0]){if(a[j][1])np++;else nn++;j++;}U+=np*(below+0.5*nn);below+=nn;i=j;}return U;}
function stratAUC(rows,key,skey){const by=new Map();for(const r of rows){const v=r[key];if(v==null)continue;const k=skey?r[skey]:"_";let g=by.get(k);if(!g){g={p:[],n:[]};by.set(k,g);}(r.y===1?g.p:g.n).push(v);}
  let U=0,P=0;for(const g of by.values()){if(!g.p.length||!g.n.length)continue;U+=mannU(g.p,g.n);P+=g.p.length*g.n.length;}return P?U/P:NaN;}

/* ---------- chart tooltip ---------- */
const tipEl=$("#chart-tip");
function showTip(target,html){tipEl.innerHTML=html;tipEl.style.display="block";const b=target.getBoundingClientRect();const tw=tipEl.offsetWidth,th=tipEl.offsetHeight;
  let x=b.left+b.width/2-tw/2+window.scrollX;x=Math.max(8+window.scrollX,Math.min(x,window.scrollX+document.documentElement.clientWidth-tw-8));
  let y=b.top+window.scrollY-th-8;if(y<window.scrollY+56)y=b.bottom+window.scrollY+8;tipEl.style.left=x+"px";tipEl.style.top=y+"px";
  $$(".mark.hot").forEach(m=>m.classList.remove("hot"));target.classList.add("hot");}
function hideTip(){tipEl.style.display="none";$$(".mark.hot").forEach(m=>m.classList.remove("hot"));}
function bindMark(el,html){el.setAttribute("tabindex","0");el.setAttribute("role","img");el.classList.add("mark");
  const txt=html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();el.setAttribute("aria-label",txt);
  el.addEventListener("pointerenter",()=>showTip(el,html));el.addEventListener("pointerleave",hideTip);
  el.addEventListener("focus",()=>showTip(el,html));el.addEventListener("blur",hideTip);
  el.addEventListener("click",e=>{e.stopPropagation();showTip(el,html);});}
document.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(!e.target.closest(".mark"))hideTip();});
document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Escape")hideTip();});
window.addEventListener("scroll",()=>{if(tipEl.style.display==="block"&&!document.activeElement.classList.contains("mark"))hideTip();},{passive:true});

/* ---------- svg helpers ---------- */
function S(tag,attrs,parent){const e=document.createElementNS(NS,tag);for(const k in attrs)e.setAttribute(k,attrs[k]);if(parent)parent.appendChild(e);return e;}
function T(parent,x,y,txt,attrs){const t=S("text",Object.assign({x,y},attrs||{}),parent);t.textContent=txt;return t;}
function svgFor(el,h,label){el.innerHTML="";const w=Math.max(280,el.clientWidth||600);const svg=S("svg",{viewBox:`0 0 ${w} ${h}`,width:w,height:h,role:"group","aria-label":label},el);return {svg,w,h};}
function legend(el,items){el.innerHTML=items.map(i=>`<span><i class="sw" style="background:${i.color}${i.border?";border:1px solid "+i.border:""}"></i>${esc(i.label)}</span>`).join("");}

/* grouped vertical bars, y in [0,yMax], bars start at zero */
function groupedBars(el,o){
  const narrow=(el.clientWidth||600)<520;const H=o.height||(narrow?260:290);
  const {svg,w,h}=svgFor(el,H,o.aria);const m={l:48,r:10,t:18,b:o.xlab2?58:42};const iw=w-m.l-m.r,ih=h-m.t-m.b;
  const y=v=>m.t+ih-(v/o.yMax)*ih;
  const g=S("g",{class:"grid"},svg),ax=S("g",{class:"axis"},svg);
  for(let v=0;v<=o.yMax+1e-9;v+=o.yStep){S("line",{x1:m.l,x2:w-m.r,y1:y(v),y2:y(v)},g);T(ax,m.l-6,y(v)+4,v.toFixed(o.yStep<0.1?2:1),{"text-anchor":"end"});}
  S("line",{x1:m.l,x2:w-m.r,y1:y(0),y2:y(0)},ax);
  const yl=T(ax,12,m.t+ih/2,o.yLabel,{"text-anchor":"middle",transform:`rotate(-90 12 ${m.t+ih/2})`});
  const G=o.groups.length,gw=iw/G;
  o.groups.forEach((gr,gi)=>{const nb=gr.bars.length;const pad=Math.min(28,gw*0.18);const bw=Math.min(64,(gw-pad*2)/nb);const x0=m.l+gi*gw+(gw-bw*nb)/2;
    gr.bars.forEach((b,bi)=>{if(b.value==null||isNaN(b.value))return;const x=x0+bi*bw+2;const r=S("rect",{x,y:y(b.value),width:Math.max(2,bw-4),height:Math.max(0,y(0)-y(b.value)),fill:b.color,rx:2},svg);
      if(b.stroke){r.setAttribute("stroke",b.stroke);}
      if(!reduce){r.style.transition="y .25s, height .25s";}
      bindMark(r,b.tip);T(svg,x+(bw-4)/2,y(b.value)-5,(b.fmt||f3)(b.value),{"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":narrow?10:12,fill:"#1b1d21","font-family":"system-ui,sans-serif"});});
    T(ax,m.l+gi*gw+gw/2,h-m.b+18,gr.label,{"text-anchor":"middle"});if(gr.label2)T(ax,m.l+gi*gw+gw/2,h-m.b+34,gr.label2,{"text-anchor":"middle"});});
  if(o.ref!=null){S("line",{x1:m.l,x2:w-m.r,y1:y(o.ref),y2:y(o.ref),stroke:"#1b1d21","stroke-dasharray":"4 4","stroke-width":1},svg);T(svg,w-m.r,y(o.ref)-5,o.refLabel,{"text-anchor":"end","font-size":11,fill:"#4a4f57","font-family":"system-ui,sans-serif"});}
  if(o.xLabel)T(ax,m.l+iw/2,h-4,o.xLabel,{"text-anchor":"middle"});
}
/* horizontal bars, x in [0,1] */
function hBars(el,o){
  const narrow=(el.clientWidth||600)<520;const rowH=narrow?30:28;const lw=narrow?118:190;
  const H=o.rows.length*rowH+56;const {svg,w,h}=svgFor(el,H,o.aria);const m={l:lw,r:44,t:10,b:40};const iw=w-m.l-m.r;
  const x=v=>m.l+(v/o.xMax)*iw;const g=S("g",{class:"grid"},svg),ax=S("g",{class:"axis"},svg);
  for(let v=0;v<=o.xMax+1e-9;v+=o.xStep){S("line",{x1:x(v),x2:x(v),y1:m.t,y2:h-m.b},g);T(ax,x(v),h-m.b+16,v.toFixed(1),{"text-anchor":"middle"});}
  T(ax,m.l+iw/2,h-6,o.xLabel,{"text-anchor":"middle"});
  o.rows.forEach((r,i)=>{const yy=m.t+i*rowH;const bh=rowH-10;
    const lab=T(ax,m.l-8,yy+bh/2+4,r.label,{"text-anchor":"end"});if(r.bold)lab.setAttribute("font-weight","700");
    if(r.value==null||isNaN(r.value))return;
    const rect=S("rect",{x:x(0),y:yy+2,width:Math.max(1,x(r.value)-x(0)),height:bh,fill:r.color,rx:2},svg);bindMark(rect,r.tip);
    T(svg,x(r.value)+4,yy+bh/2+6,f3(r.value),{"font-size":12,fill:"#1b1d21","font-family":"system-ui,sans-serif"});});
  S("line",{x1:x(0),x2:x(0),y1:m.t,y2:h-m.b},ax);
  if(o.ref!=null){S("line",{x1:x(o.ref),x2:x(o.ref),y1:m.t,y2:h-m.b,stroke:"#1b1d21","stroke-dasharray":"4 4"},svg);T(svg,x(o.ref)+3,m.t+10,o.refLabel,{"font-size":11,fill:"#4a4f57","font-family":"system-ui,sans-serif"});}
}

/* ---------- redraw on resize ---------- */
const redrawers=[];let rT=null,lastW=0;
window.addEventListener("resize",()=>{clearTimeout(rT);rT=setTimeout(()=>{const w=document.documentElement.clientWidth;if(w===lastW)return;lastW=w;redrawers.forEach(f=>f());},120);});

/* ---------- 1. headline ---------- */
const COND_NAME={SIG:"shared signature (R_COMP-SIG)",E:"free vocabulary, development set E",FREE:"free vocabulary, untouched R_COMP FREE (provisional labels)"};
const hl={cond:"SIG",view:"disg",slice:"all"};
function hlPop(cond,view){
  if(cond==="SIG"){const jk=view==="disg"?"jd":"jo";return SR.filter(r=>(r.lab==="ERROR"||r.lab==="CORRECT")&&r.c!=null&&r[jk]!=null).map(r=>({y:r.lab==="ERROR"?1:0,st:SS[r.s].tpl,t:SS[r.s].wt,c:r.c,j:r[jk]}));}
  if(cond==="E"){const jk=view==="disg"?"jd":"jo";return ER.filter(r=>r.c!=null&&r[jk]!=null).map(r=>({y:r.y,st:ES[r.s].st,t:eTerc(ES[r.s].w),c:r.c,j:r[jk]}));}
  const jk=view==="disg"?"jd":"jo";return FR.filter(r=>r[jk]!=null).map(r=>({y:r.y,st:r.tpl,t:r.wt,c:r.c,j:r[jk]}));}
function tercLabel(cond,t){if(cond==="E"){return t==="T1"?`≤${Q1} words`:t==="T2"?`${Q1+1}–${Q2} words`:`>${Q2} words`;}
  const r=sigWordRange[{T1:"W1",T2:"W2",T3:"W3"}[t]||t];return r?`${r[0]}–${r[1]} words`:"";}
function drawHeadline(){
  const pop=hlPop(hl.cond,hl.view);const judgeName=hl.view==="disg"?"flash-lite judge, disguised":"flash-lite judge, original text";
  const strat=hl.cond==="E"?"source stratum":"template";
  const cons=hl.cond==="SIG"?"c_score_sig":"c_score_align";
  const lab=hl.cond==="FREE"?["ERROR_CERT","MAPPED"]:["ERROR","CORRECT"];
  let groups=[];const res=[];
  const slices=hl.slice==="all"?[["all","All rows",null]]:(hl.cond==="E"?[["T1","Short",null],["T2","Medium",null],["T3","Long",null]]:[["W1","Short",null],["W2","Medium",null],["W3","Long",null]]);
  for(const [key,name] of slices){const rows=key==="all"?pop:pop.filter(r=>r.t===key);
    const ne=rows.filter(r=>r.y===1).length,nc=rows.length-ne;const ac=stratAUC(rows,"c","st"),aj=stratAUC(rows,"j","st");res.push({key,name,ac,aj,n:rows.length,ne,nc});
    const tk=key==="all"?"":{W1:"T1",W2:"T2",W3:"T3"}[key]||key;
    const rng=key==="all"?"":tercLabel(hl.cond,tk);
    const base=`${esc(name)}${rng?" ("+rng+")":""}<br>n = ${rows.length} (${ne} ${lab[0]} / ${nc} ${lab[1]})`;
    groups.push({label:name,label2:rng,bars:[{value:ac,color:"var(--accent)",tip:`<b>Consensus (${cons})</b><br>${base}<br>AUROC ${f3(ac)}`},{value:aj,color:"var(--base)",tip:`<b>${judgeName}</b><br>${base}<br>AUROC ${f3(aj)}`}]});}
  groupedBars($("#hl-chart"),{groups,yMax:1,yStep:0.2,yLabel:`Stratified AUROC (by ${strat})`,ref:0.5,refLabel:"chance 0.5",xlab2:hl.slice!=="all",aria:`Bar chart: AUROC of consensus and ${judgeName}, ${COND_NAME[hl.cond]}`});
  legend($("#hl-legend"),[{label:`Consensus (${cons})`,color:"var(--accent)"},{label:`Baseline: ${judgeName}`,color:"var(--base)"}]);
  const rec=REC[hl.cond][hl.view];const all=res[0];
  if(hl.slice==="all"){
    $("#hl-readout").innerHTML=`<div>n = <b>${all.n}</b></div><div>Consensus <b>${f3(all.ac)}</b></div><div>Judge <b>${f3(all.aj)}</b></div><div>Δ <b>${sgn(all.ac-all.aj)}</b> <span class="small">95% CI [${sgn(rec.ci[0])}, ${sgn(rec.ci[1])}] (recorded)</span></div>`;
    let t=`On ${COND_NAME[hl.cond]}, consensus scores <strong>${f3(all.ac)}</strong> against <strong>${f3(all.aj)}</strong> for the ${judgeName}, a gap of <strong>${sgn(all.ac-all.aj)}</strong> whose recorded 95% CI excludes zero.`;
    if(hl.cond!=="SIG")t+=` That is ${f3(REC.SIG[hl.view].delta-(all.ac-all.aj))} less than the gap under shared signature against the same judge input.`;
    $("#hl-take").innerHTML=t;
  }else{
    $("#hl-readout").innerHTML=res.map(r=>`<div>${r.name}: Δ <b>${sgn(r.ac-r.aj)}</b> <span class="small">(n = ${r.n})</span></div>`).join("");
    const cs=res.map(r=>r.ac),span=Math.max(...cs)-Math.min(...cs);
    $("#hl-take").innerHTML=span<0.03?`Across length terciles consensus stays between <strong>${f3(Math.min(...cs))}</strong> and <strong>${f3(Math.max(...cs))}</strong>: flat with length, while the judge sits between ${f3(Math.min(...res.map(r=>r.aj)))} and ${f3(Math.max(...res.map(r=>r.aj)))}.`
      :`Consensus falls from <strong>${f3(res[0].ac)}</strong> on the shortest tercile to <strong>${f3(res[2].ac)}</strong> on the longest; the gap over the judge goes from ${sgn(res[0].ac-res[0].aj)} to ${sgn(res[2].ac-res[2].aj)}.`;
  }
  const notes={SIG:"221 templated sentences, 10 translator slots given the same predicate signature; labels are pure Z3 equivalence to trusted weak or strong readings. Rows where the judge score is missing are left out, so both metrics see the same items.",
    E:`8,507 candidates from 700 sentences; the R_AB population (both panellists agree) has 2,686 rows. Terciles here split sentence length at ${Q1} and ${Q2} words, the cut of the paper's mechanism analysis.`,
    FREE:"Same 221 R_COMP sentences, each translator choosing its own predicate names. The labelling gate failed twice, so these are provisional ERROR_CERT against MAPPED labels on untouched rows; MAPPED is an upper bound on CORRECT. Not a confirmation."};
  $("#hl-note").textContent="AUROC computed on this page from the per-item scores. "+notes[hl.cond];
}
function setTabs(container,btn){$$('[role="tab"]',container).forEach(b=>{const on=b===btn;b.setAttribute("aria-selected",on);b.tabIndex=on?0:-1;});}
function tabKeys(container,onSelect){container.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{const tabs=$$('[role="tab"]',container);const i=tabs.indexOf(document.activeElement);if(i<0)return;
  let j=null;if(e.key==="ArrowRight")j=(i+1)%tabs.length;else if(e.key==="ArrowLeft")j=(i-1+tabs.length)%tabs.length;else if(e.key==="Home")j=0;else if(e.key==="End")j=tabs.length-1;
  if(j!=null){e.preventDefault();tabs[j].focus();onSelect(tabs[j]);}});
  $$('[role="tab"]',container).forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",()=>onSelect(b)));}
tabKeys($("#cond-tabs"),b=>{setTabs($("#cond-tabs"),b);hl.cond=b.dataset.cond;$("#hl-chart").setAttribute("aria-labelledby",b.id);drawHeadline();});
$$('input[name="hl-view"]').forEach(r=>r.addEventListener("change",()=>{hl.view=r.value;drawHeadline();}));
$("#hl-slice").addEventListener("change",e=>{hl.slice=e.target.value;drawHeadline();});
redrawers.push(drawHeadline);
$("#big-delta").textContent=sgn(REC.SIG.disg.delta);
$("#big-ci").textContent=`[${sgn(REC.SIG.disg.ci[0])}, ${sgn(REC.SIG.disg.ci[1])}]`;

/* ---------- 2. stepper ---------- */
const exS=SS.findIndex(s=>s.id==="0db01112acd4");const exSent=SS[exS];
const exRows=bySent.get(exS).slice().sort((a,b)=>a.slot.localeCompare(b.slot,undefined,{numeric:true}));
const classColor=k=>k==null?"#c9c9c3":["var(--c1)","var(--c2)","var(--c4)","var(--c3)","var(--c5)"][k%5];
const classes=new Map();exRows.forEach(r=>{if(!classes.has(r.k))classes.set(r.k,[]);classes.get(r.k).push(r);});
const labBadge=l=>`<span class="badge ${l==="ERROR"||l==="CORRECT"?"b-"+l:"b-other"}">${esc(l)}</span>`;
function candCard(r,extra){return `<div class="cand" style="border-left-color:${classColor(r.k)}"><div class="meta"><strong>${esc(r.slot)}</strong><span>${esc(r.sys)}</span><span>family: ${esc(r.fam)}</span>${extra||""}</div><div class="fol">${esc(r.fol)}</div></div>`;}
const nErr=exRows.filter(r=>r.lab==="ERROR").length;
const STAGES=[
 {name:"Sentence",short:"Sentence",
  body:()=>`<div class="io"><div><h4>Goes in</h4>One natural-language sentence from R_COMP, template ${esc(exSent.tpl)}: ${exSent.w} words, ${exSent.nc} conditions, clause type <em>${esc(exSent.cl.replace(/_/g," "))}</em>.</div><div><h4>What is done</h4>Nothing yet. No gold formula is shown to any translator or to the metric.</div><div><h4>Why</h4>Long sentences with exception clauses are where gold is scarcest and translations go wrong most often.</div></div><p class="sent" style="font-size:1.1rem;margin-top:14px">“${esc(exSent.t)}”</p>`},
 {name:"Peer translations",short:"Translate",
  body:()=>`<div class="io"><div><h4>Goes in</h4>The sentence and a supplied predicate signature (shared vocabulary), with the same few-shot prompt for every model.</div><div><h4>What is done</h4>${exRows.length} translator slots from different vendor families each write one FOL formula, independently.</div><div><h4>Comes out</h4>${exRows.length} candidate formulas. Each one is scored against the others.</div></div><div class="cands">${exRows.map(r=>candCard(r)).join("")}</div>`},
 {name:"Z3 equivalence classes",short:"Check with Z3",
  body:()=>{const cl=Array.from(classes.entries()).sort((a,b)=>b[1].length-a[1].length);
   return `<div class="io"><div><h4>Goes in</h4>All ${exRows.length} formulas, over the same symbols.</div><div><h4>What is done</h4>Z3 checks every pair for logical equivalence. With a shared signature no predicate alignment is needed, so equivalence is exact and groups the formulas into classes.</div><div><h4>Comes out</h4>${cl.length} classes, sized ${cl.map(c=>c[1].length).join(", ")}. Formulas that look different can land in the same class: A ∧ ¬B → C and A → (C ∨ B) are equivalent.</div></div>
   ${cl.map(([k,rs],i)=>`<h4 style="margin-top:14px"><span class="sw" style="background:${classColor(k)}"></span> Class ${i+1}: ${rs.length} translation${rs.length>1?"s":""}</h4><div class="cands">${rs.map(r=>candCard(r)).join("")}</div>`).join("")}`;}},
 {name:"Consensus score",short:"Score",
  body:()=>`<div class="io"><div><h4>Goes in</h4>Each candidate’s class and the classes of its peers from <em>other</em> families (same-family slots and unparseable outputs do not vote).</div><div><h4>What is done</h4><span class="formula">c = 1 − <span class="frac"><span>equivalent peers</span><span>peers</span></span></span><br>the share of cross-family peers that disagree.</div><div><h4>Comes out</h4>One score per candidate in [0, 1]; higher means more likely an error. The recorded scores are shown.</div></div>
   <div class="cands">${exRows.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.c-a.c).map(r=>candCard(r,`<span>peers ${r.np}, equivalent ${r.ne}</span><span>c = 1 − ${r.ne}/${r.np} = <strong>${f3(r.c)}</strong></span><span class="meter" style="max-width:160px"><i style="width:${100*r.c}%"></i></span>`)).join("")}</div>`},
 {name:"Check against the label",short:"Verdict",
  body:()=>{const cf=exRows.filter(r=>r.c>=0.5),jf=exRows.filter(r=>r.jd!=null&&r.jd>0.5);
   const cHit=cf.filter(r=>r.lab==="ERROR").length,jHit=jf.filter(r=>r.lab==="ERROR").length;
   return `<div class="io"><div><h4>Goes in</h4>The consensus score, the disguised flash-lite judge’s score, and the Z3 label: equivalence to a trusted weak or strong reading, never seen by the metric.</div><div><h4>What is done</h4>Flag at the frozen thresholds (consensus ≥ 0.5, judge &gt; 0.5) and compare with the label.</div><div><h4>Comes out</h4>Consensus flags ${cf.length} translation${cf.length===1?"":"s"}, ${cHit} of the ${nErr} errors. The judge flags ${jf.length}, ${jHit} of them errors.</div></div>
   <details><summary>Show the two reference readings used for the label</summary><p class="small">Weak reading</p><div class="fol">${esc(exSent.rw)}</div><p class="small">Strong reading</p><div class="fol">${esc(exSent.rs)}</div></details>
   <div class="cands">${exRows.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.c-a.c).map(r=>candCard(r,`${labBadge(r.lab)}<span>consensus ${f3(r.c)} ${r.c>=0.5?'<span class="badge b-flag">flagged</span>':'<span class="badge b-pass">passed</span>'}</span><span>judge ${f3(r.jd)} ${r.jd>0.5?'<span class="badge b-flag">flagged</span>':'<span class="badge b-pass">passed</span>'}</span>`)).join("")}</div>
   <p class="takeaway">Errors are rarely made the same way twice, so each wrong translation ends up alone in its class and every peer disagrees with it. The judge reads the disguised sentence and formula and has no such anchor.</p>`;}}
];
let stage=0;
function drawPipe(){const el=$("#pipe");el.innerHTML="";const w=Math.max(300,el.clientWidth||700);const narrow=w<620;const n=STAGES.length;const gap=narrow?8:22;const bw=(w-gap*(n-1))/n;const h=narrow?64:58;
  const svg=S("svg",{viewBox:`0 0 ${w} ${h}`,width:w,height:h,role:"group","aria-label":"Pipeline stages"},el);
  STAGES.forEach((s,i)=>{const x=i*(bw+gap);if(i>0){S("line",{x1:x-gap,x2:x,y1:h/2,y2:h/2,stroke:"#b5b5ae","stroke-width":2},svg);}
    const g=S("g",{class:"node"+(i<stage?" done":""),tabindex:0,role:"button","aria-label":`Stage ${i+1}: ${s.name}`},svg);
    if(i===stage)g.setAttribute("aria-current","step");
    S("rect",{x:x+1,y:4,width:bw-2,height:h-8,rx:8},g);
    if(narrow){T(g,x+bw/2,h/2-2,String(i+1),{"text-anchor":"middle",class:"num","font-size":14});T(g,x+bw/2,h/2+14,s.short.split(" ")[0],{"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":10});}
    else{T(g,x+12,h/2+5,String(i+1),{class:"num"});T(g,x+28,h/2+5,s.short,{});}
    g.addEventListener("click",()=>go(i));g.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Enter"||e.key===" "){e.preventDefault();go(i);}});});}
function go(i,fromKey){stage=Math.max(0,Math.min(STAGES.length-1,i));$("#stage-body").innerHTML=`<h3 style="margin-top:0">Stage ${stage+1}. ${STAGES[stage].name}</h3>`+STAGES[stage].body();
  $("#step-prev").disabled=stage===0;$("#step-next").disabled=stage===STAGES.length-1;$("#step-pos").textContent=`Stage ${stage+1} of ${STAGES.length}`;
  $("#step-live").textContent=`Stage ${stage+1} of ${STAGES.length}: ${STAGES[stage].name}`;drawPipe();
  if(!fromKey){const cur=$('#pipe [aria-current="step"]');if(document.activeElement&&document.activeElement.closest&&document.activeElement.closest("#pipe")&&cur)cur.focus();}}
$("#step-prev").addEventListener("click",()=>go(stage-1));$("#step-next").addEventListener("click",()=>go(stage+1));
$("#stepper").addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.target.matches("input,select,textarea,summary"))return;if(e.key==="ArrowRight"){e.preventDefault();go(stage+1);}else if(e.key==="ArrowLeft"){e.preventDefault();go(stage-1);}});
go(0,true);redrawers.push(drawPipe);

/* ---------- 3a. item browser ---------- */
const br={ds:"SIG",lab:"all",ver:"all",sort:"c",q:"",shown:60,sel:null};
function judgeOf(r){return r.jd;}
function outcome(r){if(!(r.lab==="ERROR"||r.lab==="CORRECT")||r.c==null||r.jd==null)return null;const isE=r.lab==="ERROR";const cr=(r.c>=0.5)===isE,jr=(r.jd>0.5)===isE;return cr&&!jr?"cons":jr&&!cr?"judge":!cr&&!jr?"both-wrong":"both-right";}
function brRows(){const rows=br.ds==="SIG"?SR:ER;const sents=br.ds==="SIG"?SS:ES;const q=br.q.trim().toLowerCase();
  let out=rows.filter(r=>{if(br.lab==="ERROR"&&r.lab!=="ERROR")return false;if(br.lab==="CORRECT"&&r.lab!=="CORRECT")return false;if(br.lab==="other"&&(r.lab==="ERROR"||r.lab==="CORRECT"))return false;
    if(br.ver!=="all"&&outcome(r)!==br.ver)return false;if(q&&!(sents[r.s].t.toLowerCase().includes(q)||r.fol.toLowerCase().includes(q)))return false;return true;});
  const key={c:r=>-(r.c??-1),j:r=>-(r.jd??-1),len:r=>-sents[r.s].w,s:r=>r.s}[br.sort];out.sort((a,b)=>key(a)-key(b)||a.s-b.s||a.i-b.i);return out;}
function drawBrowser(keepSel){
  $("#br-lab").querySelector('option[value="other"]').disabled=br.ds!=="SIG";if(br.ds!=="SIG"&&br.lab==="other"){br.lab="all";$("#br-lab").value="all";}
  const rows=brRows();const sents=br.ds==="SIG"?SS:ES;const ne=rows.filter(r=>r.lab==="ERROR").length,nc=rows.filter(r=>r.lab==="CORRECT").length;
  $("#br-count").textContent=`${rows.length} translation${rows.length===1?"":"s"} match (${ne} ERROR, ${nc} CORRECT${rows.length-ne-nc?", "+(rows.length-ne-nc)+" unlabelled":""}); showing ${Math.min(br.shown,rows.length)}.`;
  const list=$("#br-list");list.innerHTML=rows.slice(0,br.shown).map(r=>`<li><button type="button" aria-pressed="${br.sel===r.i}" data-i="${r.i}"><span class="l1">${labBadge(r.lab)}<span>c ${f2(r.c)}</span><span>judge ${f2(r.jd)}</span><span class="small">${esc(r.sys)}</span></span><span class="l2">${esc(sents[r.s].t)}</span></button></li>`).join("")||`<li style="padding:12px">No translation matches these filters.</li>`;
  $("#br-more").hidden=rows.length<=br.shown;
  if(!keepSel||br.sel==null||!rows.some(r=>r.i===br.sel)){br.sel=rows.length?rows[0].i:null;const b=list.querySelector("button");if(b)b.setAttribute("aria-pressed","true");}
  drawDetail();
  // takeaway
  const lab2=rows.filter(r=>outcome(r));const cnt={cons:0,judge:0,"both-wrong":0,"both-right":0};lab2.forEach(r=>cnt[outcome(r)]++);
  const dsn=br.ds==="SIG"?"shared-signature":"free-vocabulary";
  $("#br-take").innerHTML=lab2.length?`Among the ${lab2.length} labelled ${dsn} translations shown by these filters, consensus is right where the judge is wrong <strong>${cnt.cons}</strong> times; the judge is right where consensus is wrong <strong>${cnt.judge}</strong> times; both miss <strong>${cnt["both-wrong"]}</strong>.`:"These filters leave no labelled translation with both scores.";
}
function drawDetail(){const el=$("#br-detail");if(br.sel==null){el.innerHTML="<p>Select a translation from the list.</p>";return;}
  const isSig=br.ds==="SIG";const r=(isSig?SR:ER)[br.sel];const s=(isSig?SS:ES)[r.s];let right="";
  if(isSig){const peers=bySent.get(r.s).filter(p=>p!==r&&p.fam!==r.fam&&p.lab!=="UNPARSEABLE");const cnt=new Map();peers.forEach(p=>{if(p.k!=null)cnt.set(p.k,(cnt.get(p.k)||0)+1);});
    let best=null,bc=0;cnt.forEach((v,k)=>{if(v>bc||(v===bc&&k===r.k)){best=k;bc=v;}});const rep=peers.find(p=>p.k===best);
    right=`<h4>Largest agreeing group among its ${peers.length} cross-family peers</h4>${rep?`<p class="small">${bc} of ${peers.length} peers share this Z3 class${best===r.k?", the candidate’s own class":", which is <strong>not</strong> the candidate’s class"}.</p><div class="fol">${esc(rep.fol)}</div>`:"<p class='small'>No parseable peer.</p>"}
      <details><summary>Reference readings (used only for the label)</summary><p class="small">Weak</p><div class="fol">${esc(s.rw)}</div><p class="small">Strong</p><div class="fol">${esc(s.rs)}</div>${r.rd?`<p class="small">This candidate matches the <strong>${esc(r.rd)}</strong> reading.</p>`:""}</details>`;}
  else{const others=eBySent.get(r.s).filter(p=>p!==r);right=`<h4>Other labelled translations of this sentence (${others.length})</h4>${others.slice(0,4).map(p=>`<div class="small">${labBadge(p.lab)} ${esc(p.sys)} · c ${f2(p.c)}</div><div class="fol">${esc(p.fol)}</div>`).join("")}${others.length>4?`<p class="small">and ${others.length-4} more.</p>`:""}`;}
  const bar=(name,v,cls,flag)=>`<span>${name}</span><span class="meter ${cls}"><i style="width:${v==null?0:100*v}%"></i></span><span>${f3(v)} ${v==null?"":flag?'<span class="badge b-flag">flagged</span>':'<span class="badge b-pass">passed</span>'}</span>`;
  el.innerHTML=`<p class="small">${isSig?"R_COMP-SIG":"Set E, stratum "+esc(s.st)} · ${s.w} words</p><p class="sent">“${esc(s.t)}”</p>
   <div class="cols2"><div><h4>Candidate translation ${labBadge(r.lab)}</h4><p class="small">${esc(r.sys)} (family: ${esc(r.fam)})</p><div class="fol">${esc(r.fol)}</div>
   <div class="scores">${bar(isSig?"Consensus c_score_sig":"Consensus c_score_align",r.c,"",r.c!=null&&r.c>=0.5)}${bar("Judge, disguised",r.jd,"j",r.jd!=null&&r.jd>0.5)}${bar("Judge, original text",r.jo,"j",r.jo!=null&&r.jo>0.5)}</div>
   ${isSig?`<p class="small">Peers ${r.np}, equivalent ${r.ne}.</p>`:`<p class="small">Peer majority ${r.bm==null?"not scorable":r.bm===0?"endorses":"does not endorse"} this translation.</p>`}</div><div>${right}</div></div>`;}
$("#br-list").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("button[data-i]");if(!b)return;br.sel=+b.dataset.i;$$("#br-list button").forEach(x=>x.setAttribute("aria-pressed",x===b));drawDetail();});
[["#br-ds","ds"],["#br-lab","lab"],["#br-ver","ver"],["#br-sort","sort"]].forEach(([id,k])=>$(id).addEventListener("change",e=>{br[k]=e.target.value;br.shown=60;drawBrowser(false);}));
let qT=null;$("#br-q").addEventListener("input",e=>{clearTimeout(qT);qT=setTimeout(()=>{br.q=e.target.value;br.shown=60;drawBrowser(false);},150);});
$("#br-more").addEventListener("click",()=>{br.shown+=60;drawBrowser(true);});
drawBrowser(false);

/* ---------- 3b. metrics on E ---------- */
const MX=[["c","Consensus c_score_align","var(--accent)"],["pt","p_peer_text (fused)","var(--accent)"],["jq","Local judge Qwen-8B (disg.)","var(--base)"],["jn","Nano judge (disg.)","var(--base)"],["jd","Flash-lite judge (disg.)","var(--base)"],["jo","Flash-lite judge (orig.)","var(--base)"],["rt","Round-trip NLI (min)","#b9bcc2"],["sc5","Self-consistency (5-sample)","#b9bcc2"]];
function drawMx(){const st=$("#mx-st").value;const pop=ER.filter(r=>st==="ALL"||(st==="LONG"?["L25","L20","EXC"].includes(ES[r.s].st):ES[r.s].st===st)).map(r=>Object.assign({st:ES[r.s].st},r));
  const ne=pop.filter(r=>r.y===1).length;const rows=MX.map(([k,l,c])=>{const v=stratAUC(pop,k,"st");return {label:l,value:v,color:c,bold:k==="c",tip:`<b>${esc(l)}</b><br>${$("#mx-st").selectedOptions[0].text}<br>n = ${pop.length} (${ne} ERROR / ${pop.length-ne} CORRECT)<br>stratified AUROC ${f3(v)}`};});
  hBars($("#mx-chart"),{rows,xMax:1,xStep:0.2,xLabel:"Stratified AUROC (0.5 = chance)",ref:0.5,refLabel:"chance",aria:"Bar chart of stratified AUROC per metric on development set E"});
  legend($("#mx-legend"),[{label:"Consensus metrics",color:"var(--accent)"},{label:"LLM judges (baselines)",color:"var(--base)"},{label:"Other gold-free baselines",color:"#b9bcc2"}]);
  const c=rows[0].value;const others=rows.slice(2);const best=others.reduce((a,b)=>b.value>a.value?b:a);
  $("#mx-take").innerHTML=c>best.value?`On ${$("#mx-st").selectedOptions[0].text.toLowerCase()} (n = ${pop.length}), consensus (${f3(c)}) beats the best non-consensus baseline, ${esc(best.label)} (${f3(best.value)}), by ${sgn(c-best.value)}.`
    :`On ${$("#mx-st").selectedOptions[0].text.toLowerCase()} (n = ${pop.length}), consensus (${f3(c)}) does <strong>not</strong> beat ${esc(best.label)} (${f3(best.value)}): the advantage is not uniform across strata.`;}
$("#mx-st").addEventListener("change",drawMx);drawMx();redrawers.push(drawMx);

/* ---------- 3c. e/d by length ---------- */
function drawEd(){const reg=$('input[name="ed-reg"]:checked').value;let cells=[];
  if(reg==="E"){const rows=ER.filter(r=>r.sc);for(const t of ["T1","T2","T3"]){const rr=rows.filter(r=>eTerc(ES[r.s].w)===t);const er=rr.filter(r=>r.y===1),co=rr.filter(r=>r.y===0);
      cells.push({t,lab:tercLabel("E",t),e:er.filter(r=>r.bm===0).length/er.length,d:co.filter(r=>r.bm===1).length/co.length,ne:er.length,nc:co.length});}}
  else{const rows=SR.filter(r=>(r.lab==="ERROR"||r.lab==="CORRECT")&&r.c!=null);for(const [t,w] of [["T1","W1"],["T2","W2"],["T3","W3"]]){const rr=rows.filter(r=>SS[r.s].wt===w);const er=rr.filter(r=>r.lab==="ERROR"),co=rr.filter(r=>r.lab==="CORRECT");
      cells.push({t,lab:tercLabel("SIG",w),e:er.filter(r=>r.c<0.5).length/er.length,d:co.filter(r=>r.c>=0.5).length/co.length,ne:er.length,nc:co.length});}}
  const groups=cells.map((c,i)=>({label:["Short","Medium","Long"][i],label2:c.lab,bars:[
    {value:c.e,color:"var(--c2)",tip:`<b>Endorsement e</b>, ${["short","medium","long"][i]} (${c.lab})<br>${Math.round(c.e*c.ne)} of ${c.ne} ERROR rows endorsed<br>e = ${f3(c.e)}`},
    {value:c.d,color:"var(--c1)",tip:`<b>Divergence d</b>, ${["short","medium","long"][i]} (${c.lab})<br>${Math.round(c.d*c.nc)} of ${c.nc} CORRECT rows not endorsed<br>d = ${f3(c.d)}`},
    {value:c.e+c.d,color:"#fff",stroke:"#1b1d21",tip:`<b>e + d</b>, ${["short","medium","long"][i]}<br>${f3(c.e+c.d)}; binary AUROC = 1 − (e + d)/2 = ${f3(1-(c.e+c.d)/2)}`}]}));
  groupedBars($("#ed-chart"),{groups,yMax:1.2,yStep:0.2,yLabel:"Rate (fraction of rows)",xlab2:true,aria:"Bar chart of endorsement and divergence by sentence-length tercile"});
  legend($("#ed-legend"),[{label:"e: errors the peers endorse",color:"var(--c2)"},{label:"d: correct rows the peers reject",color:"var(--c1)"},{label:"e + d",color:"#fff",border:"#1b1d21"}]);
  const net=(cells[2].e+cells[2].d)-(cells[0].e+cells[0].d);
  $("#ed-take").innerHTML=reg==="E"?`Under free vocabulary, d climbs from <strong>${f3(cells[0].d)}</strong> to <strong>${f3(cells[2].d)}</strong> while e falls from ${f3(cells[0].e)} to ${f3(cells[2].e)}; e + d grows by <strong>${sgn(net)}</strong> (recorded CI [${f3(KC.net.ci[0])}, ${f3(KC.net.ci[1])}]). Long correct translations disagree with their peers, not errors slipping through.`
    :`Under shared signature, no error is endorsed in any tercile (e = ${f3(Math.max(...cells.map(c=>c.e)))}), and d stays between ${f3(Math.min(...cells.map(c=>c.d)))} and ${f3(Math.max(...cells.map(c=>c.d)))}; e + d changes by only ${sgn(net)} from short to long.`;
  $("#ed-note").textContent=reg==="E"?`Set E, the ${ER.filter(r=>r.sc).length} R_AB rows with at least two cross-family peers. "Endorsed" is the recorded peer-majority verdict (END_MAJ). Terciles cut at ${Q1} and ${Q2} words.`
    :"R_COMP-SIG, all 2,024 labelled rows. A row counts as endorsed when its consensus score is below 0.5, the frozen threshold. Terciles are the run's word-length terciles.";}
$$('input[name="ed-reg"]').forEach(r=>r.addEventListener("change",drawEd));drawEd();redrawers.push(drawEd);

/* ---------- 3d. k-curve ---------- */
const KS=[["all","Overall","var(--c1)"],["T1","Short tercile (T1)","var(--c3)"],["T2","Medium tercile (T2)","var(--c2)"],["T3","Long tercile (T3)","var(--c4)"]];
const kOn={all:true,T1:false,T2:false,T3:true};
$("#k-series").innerHTML=KS.map(([k,l,c])=>`<label><input type="checkbox" value="${k}" ${kOn[k]?"checked":""}><i class="sw" style="background:${c}"></i>${l}</label>`).join("");
function k95(key){const top=KC.k[KC.k.length-1][key];return KC.k.find(p=>p[key]>=0.95*top).k;}
function drawK(){const el=$("#k-chart");const narrow=(el.clientWidth||600)<520;const {svg,w,h}=svgFor(el,narrow?260:300,"Line chart of AUROC against number of peer families");
  const m={l:50,r:14,t:14,b:44};const iw=w-m.l-m.r,ih=h-m.t-m.b;const x=k=>m.l+(k-1)/6*iw;const y0=0.45,y1=0.85;const y=v=>m.t+ih-(v-y0)/(y1-y0)*ih;
  const g=S("g",{class:"grid"},svg),ax=S("g",{class:"axis"},svg);
  for(let v=0.5;v<=0.85+1e-9;v+=0.05){S("line",{x1:m.l,x2:w-m.r,y1:y(v),y2:y(v)},g);T(ax,m.l-6,y(v)+4,v.toFixed(2),{"text-anchor":"end"});}
  for(let k=1;k<=7;k++)T(ax,x(k),h-m.b+16,String(k),{"text-anchor":"middle"});
  T(ax,m.l+iw/2,h-6,"Number of peer families k",{"text-anchor":"middle"});T(ax,12,m.t+ih/2,"AUROC",{"text-anchor":"middle",transform:`rotate(-90 12 ${m.t+ih/2})`});
  S("line",{x1:m.l,x2:w-m.r,y1:y(0.5),y2:y(0.5),stroke:"#1b1d21","stroke-dasharray":"4 4"},svg);T(svg,w-m.r,y(0.5)-5,"chance 0.5",{"text-anchor":"end","font-size":11,fill:"#4a4f57"});
  if(kOn.all){const top=KC.k.map(p=>`${x(p.k)},${y(p.ci[1])}`),bot=KC.k.slice().reverse().map(p=>`${x(p.k)},${y(p.ci[0])}`);S("polygon",{points:top.concat(bot).join(" "),fill:"#0072B2","fill-opacity":0.12},svg);}
  for(const [key,l,c] of KS){if(!kOn[key])continue;S("polyline",{points:KC.k.map(p=>`${x(p.k)},${y(p[key])}`).join(" "),fill:"none",stroke:c,"stroke-width":2.5,"stroke-dasharray":key==="all"?"":"6 4"},svg);
    const kk=k95(key);KC.k.forEach(p=>{const pt=S("circle",{cx:x(p.k),cy:y(p[key]),r:p.k===kk?7:5,fill:p.k===kk?c:"#fff",stroke:c,"stroke-width":2},svg);
      bindMark(pt,`<b>${esc(l)}</b><br>k = ${p.k} families<br>AUROC ${f3(p[key])}${key==="all"?`<br>95% CI [${f3(p.ci[0])}, ${f3(p.ci[1])}]`:""}${p.k===kk?"<br>k<sub>95</sub>: first k reaching 95% of k = 7":""}`);});}
  legend($("#k-legend"),KS.filter(s=>kOn[s[0]]).map(s=>({label:s[1],color:s[2]})).concat(kOn.all?[{label:"95% CI (overall)",color:"rgba(0,114,178,.18)"}]:[]).concat([{label:"filled point = k₉₅",color:"#1b1d21"}]));
  const on=KS.filter(s=>kOn[s[0]]);$("#k-take").innerHTML=on.length?on.map(s=>`${s[1]}: k<sub>95</sub> = <strong>${k95(s[0])}</strong> (AUROC ${f3(KC.k[0][s[0]])} at k = 1, ${f3(KC.k[6][s[0]])} at k = 7)`).join("; ")+". Longer sentences need more families before the vote settles.":"Tick a series to draw it.";
  $("#k-note").textContent=`Set E rows where all 7 other families are available: n = ${KC.n} (${KC.n_err} ERROR / ${KC.n_cor} CORRECT, ${KC.n_sent} sentences). Pooled AUROC averaged over 50 random draws of k families per row, as recorded by the mechanism analysis; the page does not redraw families here.`;}
$("#k-series").addEventListener("change",e=>{kOn[e.target.value]=e.target.checked;drawK();});drawK();redrawers.push(drawK);

/* ---------- 4. try it ---------- */
const FAMS=SIGD.families;const famOn=new Set(FAMS);
$("#try-fams").innerHTML=FAMS.map(f=>`<label><input type="checkbox" value="${esc(f)}" checked>${esc(f)}</label>`).join("");
const tryBase=SR.filter(r=>r.lab==="ERROR"||r.lab==="CORRECT");
function recompute(){const out=[];for(const r of tryBase){if(r.k==null)continue;const peers=bySent.get(r.s).filter(p=>p!==r&&p.fam!==r.fam&&p.lab!=="UNPARSEABLE"&&famOn.has(p.fam));
    if(peers.length<2)continue;const eq=peers.filter(p=>p.k!=null&&p.k===r.k).length;out.push({y:r.lab==="ERROR"?1:0,st:SS[r.s].tpl,c:1-eq/peers.length,j:r.jd,rc:r.c});}return out;}
// self-check: with every family, the recomputed score equals the recorded c_score_sig
(function(){const all=recompute();const bad=all.filter(r=>Math.abs(r.c-r.rc)>1e-5).length;$("#try-check").textContent=`Check: with every family ticked, the page recomputes the consensus score of all ${all.length} scorable labelled rows from the recorded Z3 classes; ${bad===0?"every one matches":bad+" differ from"} the recorded c_score_sig.`;})();
function roc(rows,key){const pts=[];const P=rows.filter(r=>r.y===1).length,N=rows.length-P;const th=Array.from(new Set(rows.map(r=>r[key]))).sort((a,b)=>b-a);pts.push([0,0]);
  for(const t of th){let tp=0,fp=0;for(const r of rows){if(r[key]>=t){if(r.y)tp++;else fp++;}}pts.push([fp/N,tp/P]);}pts.push([1,1]);return pts;}
function opPoint(rows,key,t,strict){let tp=0,fp=0,P=0,N=0;for(const r of rows){const f=strict?r[key]>t:r[key]>=t;if(r.y){P++;if(f)tp++;}else{N++;if(f)fp++;}}return {rec:tp/P,fa:fp/N,prec:(tp+fp)?tp/(tp+fp):NaN,flag:tp+fp,P,N};}
function drawTry(){const t=+$("#try-t").value;$("#try-tv").textContent=t.toFixed(2);const all=recompute();const both=all.filter(r=>r.j!=null);
  const ac=stratAUC(both,"c","st"),aj=stratAUC(both,"j","st");const oc=opPoint(both,"c",t,false),oj=opPoint(both,"j",t,false);
  const excluded=tryBase.filter(r=>r.k!=null).length-all.length;
  $("#try-readout").innerHTML=`<div>Families voting <b>${famOn.size}</b> of ${FAMS.length}</div><div>Rows scored <b>${both.length}</b></div><div>Consensus AUROC <b>${f3(ac)}</b></div><div>Judge AUROC <b>${f3(aj)}</b></div>`;
  // ROC
  const el=$("#try-roc");const narrow=(el.clientWidth||500)<460;const {svg,w,h}=svgFor(el,narrow?300:330,"ROC curves of consensus and the disguised judge");const m={l:50,r:14,t:12,b:44};const side=Math.min(w-m.l-m.r,h-m.t-m.b);
  const x=v=>m.l+v*side,y=v=>m.t+side-v*side;const g=S("g",{class:"grid"},svg),ax=S("g",{class:"axis"},svg);
  for(let v=0;v<=1+1e-9;v+=0.2){S("line",{x1:x(v),x2:x(v),y1:y(0),y2:y(1)},g);S("line",{x1:x(0),x2:x(1),y1:y(v),y2:y(v)},g);T(ax,x(v),y(0)+16,v.toFixed(1),{"text-anchor":"middle"});T(ax,x(0)-6,y(v)+4,v.toFixed(1),{"text-anchor":"end"});}
  T(ax,x(0.5),y(0)+36,"False-alarm rate (share of CORRECT flagged)",{"text-anchor":"middle"});T(ax,12,y(0.5),"Recall",{"text-anchor":"middle",transform:`rotate(-90 12 ${y(0.5)})`});
  S("line",{x1:x(0),y1:y(0),x2:x(1),y2:y(1),stroke:"#1b1d21","stroke-dasharray":"4 4"},svg);
  for(const [key,col,name,o] of [["j","var(--base)","Judge (disguised)",oj],["c","var(--accent)","Consensus",oc]]){S("polyline",{points:roc(both,key).map(p=>`${x(p[0])},${y(p[1])}`).join(" "),fill:"none",stroke:col,"stroke-width":2.5},svg);
    const pt=S("circle",{cx:x(o.fa),cy:y(o.rec),r:7,fill:col,stroke:"#fff","stroke-width":2},svg);bindMark(pt,`<b>${name}</b> at threshold ${t.toFixed(2)}<br>recall ${f3(o.rec)}, false alarms ${f3(o.fa)}<br>precision ${f3(o.prec)}, ${o.flag} flagged of ${both.length}`);}
  legend($("#try-legend"),[{label:"Consensus (recomputed)",color:"var(--accent)"},{label:"Baseline: flash-lite judge, disguised",color:"var(--base)"}]);
  groupedBars($("#try-bars"),{groups:[{label:"Recall",bars:[{value:oc.rec,color:"var(--accent)",tip:`<b>Consensus</b> recall ${f3(oc.rec)} (${Math.round(oc.rec*oc.P)} of ${oc.P} errors)`},{value:oj.rec,color:"var(--base)",tip:`<b>Judge</b> recall ${f3(oj.rec)} (${Math.round(oj.rec*oj.P)} of ${oj.P} errors)`}]},
     {label:"False alarms",bars:[{value:oc.fa,color:"var(--accent)",tip:`<b>Consensus</b> false-alarm rate ${f3(oc.fa)} (${Math.round(oc.fa*oc.N)} of ${oc.N} correct)`},{value:oj.fa,color:"var(--base)",tip:`<b>Judge</b> false-alarm rate ${f3(oj.fa)} (${Math.round(oj.fa*oj.N)} of ${oj.N} correct)`}]},
     {label:"Precision",bars:[{value:oc.prec,color:"var(--accent)",tip:`<b>Consensus</b> precision ${f3(oc.prec)}`},{value:oj.prec,color:"var(--base)",tip:`<b>Judge</b> precision ${f3(oj.prec)}`}]}],
     yMax:1,yStep:0.2,yLabel:`Rate at threshold ${t.toFixed(2)}`,aria:"Bar chart of recall, false alarms and precision at the chosen threshold",height:250});
  $("#try-take").innerHTML=`With ${famOn.size} famil${famOn.size===1?"y":"ies"} voting, consensus reaches within-template AUROC <strong>${f3(ac)}</strong> against <strong>${f3(aj)}</strong> for the judge. Flagging at ${t.toFixed(2)} catches <strong>${pct(oc.rec)}</strong> of errors with a <strong>${pct(oc.fa)}</strong> false-alarm rate; the judge at the same threshold catches ${pct(oj.rec)} with ${pct(oj.fa)}.`+(excluded>0?` ${excluded} rows drop out because fewer than two eligible peers remain.`:"");}
$("#try-fams").addEventListener("change",e=>{if(e.target.checked)famOn.add(e.target.value);else famOn.delete(e.target.value);drawTry();});
$("#try-t").addEventListener("input",drawTry);drawTry();redrawers.push(drawTry);

/* ---------- 5a. reading false alarms ---------- */
function drawRd(){const sel=$('input[name="rd"]:checked').value;const cor=SR.filter(r=>r.lab==="CORRECT"&&r.c!=null);
  const st={};for(const rd of ["weak","strong"]){const cc=cor.filter(r=>r.rd===rd);st[rd]={n:cc.length,fa:cc.filter(r=>r.c>=0.5).length};}
  groupedBars($("#rd-chart"),{groups:[{label:"Weak reading",bars:[{value:st.weak.fa/st.weak.n,color:sel==="weak"?"var(--accent)":"var(--base)",tip:`<b>Correct, weak reading</b><br>${st.weak.fa} of ${st.weak.n} flagged by consensus<br>rate ${f3(st.weak.fa/st.weak.n)}`}]},
    {label:"Strong reading",bars:[{value:st.strong.fa/st.strong.n,color:sel==="strong"?"var(--accent)":"var(--base)",tip:`<b>Correct, strong reading</b><br>${st.strong.fa} of ${st.strong.n} flagged by consensus<br>rate ${f3(st.strong.fa/st.strong.n)}`}]}],
    yMax:1,yStep:0.2,yLabel:"Share of CORRECT rows flagged",height:240,aria:"Bar chart of consensus false-alarm rate by reading"});
  legend($("#rd-legend"),[{label:"Selected reading",color:"var(--accent)"},{label:"Other reading",color:"var(--base)"}]);
  const fl=cor.filter(r=>r.rd===sel&&r.c>=0.5).sort((a,b)=>b.c-a.c);$("#rd-count").textContent=`${fl.length} correct ${sel}-reading translations flagged; the first 5 by score:`;
  $("#rd-list").innerHTML=fl.slice(0,5).map(r=>`<li><div class="small">${esc(SS[r.s].t)}</div><div class="fol">${esc(r.fol)}</div><div class="small">${esc(r.sys)} · consensus ${f3(r.c)} (${r.ne} of ${r.np} peers agree)</div></li>`).join("");
  const o=sel==="strong"?"weak":"strong";
  $("#rd-take").innerHTML=`Consensus flags <strong>${pct(st[sel].fa/st[sel].n)}</strong> of correct ${sel}-reading translations against ${pct(st[o].fa/st[o].n)} of ${o}-reading ones. ${sel==="strong"?"Most peers choose the weak reading, so a correct minority reading is outvoted: these false alarms are disagreements about meaning, not mistakes.":"Weak-reading translations agree with the peer majority, so few are flagged."}`;}
$$('input[name="rd"]').forEach(r=>r.addEventListener("change",drawRd));drawRd();redrawers.push(drawRd);

/* ---------- 5b. rename tradeoff ---------- */
const RN_NAMES={c_align:"c_align (aligner)",c_nf:"c_nf (name-free)",c_hyb:"c_hyb (hybrid)",p_peer_text:"p_peer_text (fused)",judge_cheap_disg:"Judge, disguised"};
let rnF="RENAME_NONCE";
function drawRn(){if(rnF==="RECALL"){const ops=Object.keys(REN.recall);const rows=ops.map(op=>({label:op.replace("_"," ").toLowerCase().replace(/^\w/,c=>c.toUpperCase()),value:REN.recall[op],color:"var(--accent)",tip:`<b>${esc(op)}</b> mutants<br>c_align recall at the primary threshold ${f3(REN.recall[op])}`}));

class=\"kicker\">Interactive companion to the paper</p>\n    <h1>Cross-Family Solver Consensus as a Gold-Free Faithfulness Metric for Natural-Language-to-First-Order-Logic Translation</h1>\n    <p class=\"byline\">Anonymous</p>\n    <div class=\"links\">\n      <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_-tTYmHVAOMOt/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_-tTYmHVAOMOt/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic/tree/fork/run_-tTYmHVAOMOt\">Code repository</a>\n    </div>\n href=\"#evidence\">Explore the evidence</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#try\">Try it</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#fails\">Where it fails</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#about\">Glossary and data</a></li>\n  </ol>\n</nav>\n<main id=\"main\">\n\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"finding\" aria-labelledby=\"h-finding\">\n  <div class=\"wrap grid2\">\n    <div>\n      <p class=\"kicker\">The finding</p>\n      <h2 id=\"h-finding\">Other model families can grade a logic translation without a gold formula</h2>\n      <p class=\"question\">Can we tell whether a first-order logic (FOL) translation says what its sentence says when no gold formula exists?</p>\n      <div class=\"prose\">\n        <p>Gold references are expensive and often wrong: a recent audit of two standard benchmarks found errors in 39 to 42% of their annotations. The paper studies a gold-free alternative. Several independent LLM families translate the same sentence, the Z3 solver checks which translations are logically equivalent, and each candidate gets a <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"cscore\">consensus score</button>: the fraction of <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"peer\">cross-family peers</button> whose translation is not equivalent to it.</p>\n        <p>When translators share a supplied predicate vocabulary (<button class=\"term\" data-term=\"sig\">shared signature</button>), consensus reaches a <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"wt\">within-template AUROC</button> of 0.954 on 221 fresh long-exception sentences with trusted references and pure Z3 labels. A <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"disg\">disguised</button> API judge reaches 0.587 on the same items.</p>\n      </div>\n      <p class=\"bignum\" id=\"big-delta\" aria-describedby=\"big-cap\">+0.367</p>\n      <p class=\"bigcap\" id=\"big-cap\">AUROC gained over the disguised flash-lite judge on shared-signature sentences, 95% sentence-cluster bootstrap CI <span id=\"big-ci\">[+0.328, +0.404]</span>.</p>\n      <div class=\"prose\">\n        <p>Under <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"free\">free vocabulary</button>, consensus still beats the judges (+0.099 on the development set, +0.171 on untouched sentences against the original-view judge), but the gain shrinks by roughly 0.15 AUROC, and the predicate aligner that free vocabulary needs raises false alarms on meaning-preserving renames. Confirmation on independent held-out data was budget-stopped and remains incomplete.</p>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"panel\" id=\"headline\">\n      <h3 style=\"margin-top:0\">Consensus against the judge, by condition</h3>\n      <p class=\"question\" style=\"font-size:.95rem\">Does the gap hold when translators choose their own predicate names, and on longer sentences?</p>\n      <div class=\"controls\">\n        <div class=\"ctl\" style=\"width:100%\">\n          <span class=\"lbl\" id=\"cond-lbl\">Condition</span>\n          <div class=\"seg\" role=\"tablist\" aria-labelledby=\"cond-lbl\" id=\"cond-tabs\">\n            <button role=\"tab\" id=\"tab-SIG\" aria-selected=\"true\" aria-controls=\"hl-chart\" data-cond=\"SIG\">Shared signature</button>\n            <button role=\"tab\" id=\"tab-E\" aria-selected=\"false\" aria-controls=\"hl-chart\" data-cond=\"E\" tabindex=\"-1\">Free vocabulary, development</button>\n            <button role=\"tab\" id=\"tab-FREE\" aria-selected=\"false\" aria-controls=\"hl-chart\" data-cond=\"FREE\" tabindex=\"-1\">Free vocabulary, untouched</button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <fieldset class=\"ctl\">\n          <legend>Judge input</legend>\n          <div class=\"seg\">\n            <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"hl-view\" value=\"disg\" checked>Disguised</label>\n            <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"hl-view\" value=\"orig\">Original text</label>\n          </div>\n        </fieldset>\n        <div class=\"ctl\">\n          <label for=\"hl-slice\">Rows shown</label>\n          <select id=\"hl-slice\">\n            <option value=\"all\">All rows</option>\n            <option value=\"terc\">By sentence-length tercile</option>\n          </select>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"hl-chart\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"tab-SIG\"></div>\n      <div class=\"legend\" id=\"hl-legend\"></div>\n      <div class=\"readout\" id=\"hl-readout\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n      <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"hl-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n      <p class=\"note\" id=\"hl-note\"></p>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"how\" aria-labelledby=\"h-how\">\n  <div class=\"wrap\">\n    <p class=\"kicker\">How it works</p>\n    <h2 id=\"h-how\">One real sentence through the method</h2>\n    <p class=\"question\">What does the consensus score actually compute, and why does it catch errors that a judge misses?</p>\n    <div class=\"panel stepper\" id=\"stepper\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-roledescription=\"stepper\" aria-label=\"Method walkthrough. Use the left and right arrow keys to move between stages.\">\n      <div class=\"pipe\" id=\"pipe\"></div>\n      <p class=\"sr\" id=\"step-live\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n      <div class=\"stage-body\" id=\"stage-body\"></div>\n      <div class=\"stepnav\">\n        <button class=\"btn\" id=\"step-prev\" type=\"button\">Previous stage</button>\n        <button class=\"btn primary\" id=\"step-next\" type=\"button\">Next stage</button>\n        <span class=\"pos\" id=\"step-pos\"></span>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"evidence\" aria-labelledby=\"h-evidence\">\n  <div class=\"wrap\">\n    <p class=\"kicker\">Explore the evidence</p>\n    <h2 id=\"h-evidence\">The per-item records behind the numbers</h2>\n\n    <h3 id=\"h-browser\">Item browser</h3>\n    <p class=\"question\">What does a flagged translation look like, and where do consensus and the judge disagree?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\" id=\"br-controls\">\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><label for=\"br-ds\">Dataset</label>\n        <select id=\"br-ds\"><option value=\"SIG\">Shared signature (R_COMP-SIG)</option><option value=\"E\">Free vocabulary (development set E)</option></select></div>\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><label for=\"br-lab\">Label</label>\n        <select id=\"br-lab\"><option value=\"all\">All labels</option><option value=\"ERROR\">ERROR</option><option value=\"CORRECT\">CORRECT</option><option value=\"other\">Unlabelled (reading choice, off-signature, unparseable)</option></select></div>\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><label for=\"br-ver\">Who got it right</label>\n        <select id=\"br-ver\"><option value=\"all\">Any outcome</option><option value=\"cons\">Consensus right, judge wrong</option><option value=\"judge\">Judge right, consensus wrong</option><option value=\"both-wrong\">Both wrong</option><option value=\"both-right\">Both right</option></select></div>\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><label for=\"br-sort\">Sort by</label>\n        <select id=\"br-sort\"><option value=\"c\">Consensus score, high first</option><option value=\"j\">Judge score, high first</option><option value=\"len\">Longest sentence first</option><option value=\"s\">Sentence order</option></select></div>\n      <div class=\"ctl\" style=\"flex:1;min-width:200px\"><label for=\"br-q\">Search sentence or formula</label>\n        <input type=\"search\" id=\"br-q\" placeholder=\"e.g. unless, Airline, ¬\"></div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"count\" id=\"br-count\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <div class=\"browser\">\n      <div>\n        <ul class=\"list\" id=\"br-list\" aria-label=\"Matching translations\"></ul>\n        <button class=\"btn\" id=\"br-more\" type=\"button\" style=\"margin-top:8px\">Show 60 more</button>\n      </div>\n      <div class=\"panel detail\" id=\"br-detail\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"br-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\">Flags use the frozen thresholds of the shared-signature analysis: consensus flags a translation at a score of 0.5 or more, the judge flags it above 0.5. The judge here is the disguised flash-lite judge. On set E, \"endorsed\" is the recorded peer-majority verdict.</p>\n\n    <h3 id=\"h-metrics\">Every gold-free metric on the development set</h3>\n    <p class=\"question\">Does consensus beat the other gold-free signals in every kind of sentence, or only on average?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><label for=\"mx-st\">Source stratum</label>\n        <select id=\"mx-st\">\n          <option value=\"ALL\">All R_AB rows</option>\n          <option value=\"LONG\">Long pool (L25 + L20 + EXC)</option>\n          <option value=\"L25\">L25 (25 words or more)</option>\n          <option value=\"L20\">L20 (20 to 24 words)</option>\n          <option value=\"EXC\">EXC (exception clauses)</option>\n          <option value=\"CTRL\">CTRL (short control sentences)</option>\n        </select></div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"mx-chart\"></div>\n    <div class=\"legend\" id=\"mx-legend\"></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"mx-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\">Stratified AUROC computed on this page from the per-item scores of development set E (free vocabulary), pairing ERROR and CORRECT rows only inside the same source stratum. With all rows selected the values match the paper's Table 3.</p>\n\n    <h3 id=\"h-ed\">Why long sentences hurt under free vocabulary</h3>\n    <p class=\"question\">Consensus can fail in two ways: it endorses an error, or it flags a correct translation. Which one grows with sentence length?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <fieldset class=\"ctl\"><legend>Vocabulary regime</legend>\n        <div class=\"seg\">\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"ed-reg\" value=\"E\" checked>Free vocabulary (set E)</label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"ed-reg\" value=\"SIG\">Shared signature (R_COMP-SIG)</label>\n        </div></fieldset>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"ed-chart\"></div>\n    <div class=\"legend\" id=\"ed-legend\"></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"ed-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\" id=\"ed-note\"></p>\n\n    <h3 id=\"h-k\">How many peer families are enough</h3>\n    <p class=\"question\">If each extra family costs a translation call, how many do we need?</p>\n    <fieldset class=\"ctl\"><legend>Series shown</legend>\n      <div class=\"checks\" id=\"k-series\"></div></fieldset>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"k-chart\"></div>\n    <div class=\"legend\" id=\"k-legend\"></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"k-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\" id=\"k-note\"></p>\n  </div>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"try\" aria-labelledby=\"h-try\">\n  <div class=\"wrap\">\n    <p class=\"kicker\">Try it</p>\n    <h2 id=\"h-try\">Rerun the vote with fewer families and a different threshold</h2>\n    <p class=\"question\">If only some model families were available, or you wanted fewer false alarms, what would consensus look like?</p>\n    <div class=\"prose\"><p>Under shared signature, Z3 equivalence is exact, so the run's equivalence classes decide every vote. This view recomputes each candidate's consensus score from those recorded classes using only the families you tick, then recomputes the within-template AUROC and the error flags at your threshold. Nothing is simulated: every vote is a recorded Z3 verdict.</p></div>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <fieldset class=\"ctl\" style=\"width:100%\"><legend>Peer families allowed to vote</legend>\n        <div class=\"checks\" id=\"try-fams\"></div></fieldset>\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><label for=\"try-t\">Flag threshold</label>\n        <div><input type=\"range\" id=\"try-t\" min=\"0.05\" max=\"1\" step=\"0.05\" value=\"0.5\" aria-describedby=\"try-tv\"> <span class=\"rangeval\" id=\"try-tv\">0.50</span></div></div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"twocol\">\n      <div>\n        <div class=\"readout\" id=\"try-readout\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n        <div class=\"chart\" id=\"try-roc\" style=\"margin-top:12px\"></div>\n        <div class=\"legend\" id=\"try-legend\"></div>\n      </div>\n      <div>\n        <div class=\"chart\" id=\"try-bars\"></div>\n        <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"try-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n        <p class=\"note\" id=\"try-check\"></p>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"fails\" aria-labelledby=\"h-fails\">\n  <div class=\"wrap\">\n    <p class=\"kicker\">Where it fails</p>\n    <h2 id=\"h-fails\">False alarms, renames, and what remains unconfirmed</h2>\n\n    <h3 id=\"h-reading\">Correct translations of the other reading</h3>\n    <p class=\"question\">Even with a shared signature, 26% of correct translations get flagged. Which ones?</p>\n    <fieldset class=\"ctl\"><legend>Correct translations that match the</legend>\n      <div class=\"seg\">\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"rd\" value=\"strong\" checked>Strong reading</label>\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"rd\" value=\"weak\">Weak reading</label>\n      </div></fieldset>\n    <div class=\"twocol\" style=\"margin-top:12px\">\n      <div><div class=\"chart\" id=\"rd-chart\"></div><div class=\"legend\" id=\"rd-legend\"></div></div>\n      <div><p class=\"count\" id=\"rd-count\"></p><ul class=\"fa-list\" id=\"rd-list\"></ul></div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"rd-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n\n    <h3 id=\"h-rename\">The rename tradeoff</h3>\n    <p class=\"question\">If a correct formula only renames its predicates, does the score change?</p>\n    <div class=\"seg\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Rewrite family\" id=\"rn-tabs\">\n      <button role=\"tab\" aria-selected=\"true\" aria-controls=\"rn-chart\" data-f=\"RENAME_NONCE\" id=\"rn-NONCE\">Nonce renames</button>\n      <button role=\"tab\" aria-selected=\"false\" aria-controls=\"rn-chart\" data-f=\"RENAME_SYN\" id=\"rn-SYN\" tabindex=\"-1\">Synonym renames</button>\n      <button role=\"tab\" aria-selected=\"false\" aria-controls=\"rn-chart\" data-f=\"RECALL\" id=\"rn-REC\" tabindex=\"-1\">Recall by error type</button>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"rn-chart\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"rn-NONCE\" style=\"margin-top:12px\"></div>\n    <div class=\"legend\" id=\"rn-legend\"></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"rn-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\">Development set E, PERTURB suite: meaning-preserving renames of CORRECT base formulas. <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"flip\">Flip</button> is the false-alarm rate the rename alone adds (FA minus base FA). Recall is at the primary threshold on typed mutants.</p>\n\n    <h3 id=\"h-limits\">What the paper does not show</h3>\n    <ul class=\"limits\">\n      <li><strong>No completed confirmation.</strong> A fresh held-out set (E2-A, 550 new sentences) was built, but the run's budget ran out before enough items were labelled. On its one testable stratum (DT, short ProverQA sentences) consensus reaches a stratified AUROC of 0.916 and ties a local Qwen-8B judge (Δ = +0.003 [−0.042, +0.052]). On L25 sentences it falls to 0.443 on only 42 items (35 ERROR / 7 CORRECT from 3 sentences), an estimate with extreme variance. Every pre-registered criterion on the target strata returned NOT_TESTABLE or unfavourable.</li>\n      <li><strong>Shared-signature scope.</strong> The 0.954 result uses templated sentences with a supplied predicate vocabulary, which removes the alignment problem. It does not extend to translators who choose their own predicate names.</li>\n      <li><strong>Development data overlap.</strong> R_COMP-SIG later served as development data for aligner tuning, so the development-set numbers from E are not independent of it.</li>\n      <li><strong>Rename vulnerability.</strong> Under free vocabulary, a 76.5% false-alarm rate on nonce renames means the metric penalises translations with non-standard predicate names even when they are correct.</li>\n      <li><strong>Length degradation.</strong> Under free vocabulary, discrimination degrades with sentence length (NET +0.356), driven by correct translations that diverge. The metric is weakest on the long, heavily conditioned sentences where gold-free evaluation matters most.</li>\n      <li><strong>Provisional labels.</strong> R_COMP FREE uses provisional labels because the gloss gate failed twice (balanced accuracy 0.776, then 0.561, against a 0.90 bar). On the two-auditor subset the gain over the original-view judge is +0.105 [+0.011, +0.215], a CI that barely excludes zero.</li>\n      <li><strong>Label dependence and domain.</strong> Labels on E come from a panel whose agreement is imperfect. All results are English to FOL from MALLS, ProverQA and R_COMP; other formalisms, languages and sentence distributions are untested.</li>\n      <li><strong>Cost.</strong> At k = 9, consensus costs $0.91 per 10,000 candidates (amortised); a single cheap judge call costs $0.51 per 10,000.</li>\n    </ul>\n  </div>\n</section>\n</main>\n\n<footer class=\"bottom\" id=\"about\" aria-labelledby=\"h-about\">\n  <div class=\"wrap\">\n    <h2 id=\"h-about\">Glossary, data and links</h2>\n    <div class=\"links\" style=\"margin:0 0 24px\">\n      <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_-tTYmHVAOMOt/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_-tTYmHVAOMOt/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic/tree/fork/run_-tTYmHVAOMOt\">Code repository</a>\n    </div>\n    <h3>Glossary</h3>\n    <dl class=\"gloss\" id=\"gloss\"></dl>\n    <h3>Where each view's data comes from</h3>\n    <ul class=\"prov\" id=\"prov\"></ul>\n    <p class=\"note\">Embedded data is trimmed to the fields the views use. Scores are rounded to six decimals, as the run's own method outputs record them. Confidence intervals come from the artifacts' recorded sentence-cluster bootstraps; the page does not resample.</p>\n  </div>\n</footer>\n<div id=\"chart-tip\" role=\"tooltip\"></div>\n<div **Numbers match the paper.** A script reads the run's per-item files and writes the JSON the page embeds. From that data it reproduced every headline number:
- Shared signature: 0.954 vs 0.587 on the 1,904 rows where both scores exist.
- Development set E: 0.741 vs 0.642.

- Also the error-rate breakdown by sentence length, the families curve, and the rename false-alarm rates.

The page computes AUROC live from the embedded rows. Confidence intervals are the run's own recorded values, because the page doesn't resample.

**What's on the page:**
- **The finding:** the +0.367 headline next to a chart of consensus against the judge. You can switch between the three conditions, the judge's input (disguised or original text), and all rows vs. sentence-length terciles.
- **How it works:** a five-stage walk-through of one real sentence. The ten translations fall into three Z3 classes of 8, 1 and 1. Consensus flags exactly the two errors. The disguised judge scores both errors 0.05 (faithful) and flags two correct translations instead.
- **Explore the evidence:**
  - An item browser over 2,210 shared-signature and 2,686 development-set translations. Each item shows the candidate formula beside the largest agreeing group of peers and the reference readings.
  - Every metric on development set E, by sentence stratum. It shows consensus losing to the judge on the short control sentences.
  - The two failure rates by sentence length.
  - AUROC against the number of peer families.
- **Try it:** tick which families vote and move a threshold slider. Scores are recomputed from the recorded Z3 classes, and the page checks that with every family ticked it reproduces all 2,024 recorded scores exactly.
- **Where it fails:** correct translations of the minority "strong" reading are flagged 96.5% of the time (14.3% for the "weak" reading), with real examples. Then the rename tradeoff charts, and the paper's own limits, including the unfinished held-out confirmation.
